articles.title: Marvel's 'Wonder Man' Creators Joke About Winning an 'Auteur' Award
articles.summary: Two creators of a Marvel show joked that they don't fit the 'auteur' label. But they proved superhero shows can be artistic too!

articles.title: How 'Spider-Noir' VFX Team Made the Show Look Amazing—With No Room for Mistakes
articles.summary: The visual effects team for 'Spider-Noir' had to be super strict about their plans. One wrong move could blow the budget or ruin the show's tone!

articles.title: 'The Vampire Lestat' Is a Wild Rock Opera That Doesn't Care If You're Confused
articles.summary: The new show 'The Vampire Lestat' is the third season of 'Interview with the Vampire.' It's a crazy rock opera with a vampire who starts a band. Confusing but thrilling!
